items.difficulty_reason: The augmentation of the Cech complex of a covering is a homotopy equivalence: replaces (U, f) by U' = U x_X X (fibre product of Categories, 2-product-categories-over-C) whose projection has a strict section s', using lemma-generalities to justify the replacement, then defines h^n as pullback along s_n with s_{-1} = s and h^0 as pullback along s_{-1}, exhibiting a homotopy between 1 and 0 on the extended complex. Retained author proof at lines 3258-3296.
